core_features: Crime, moral ambiguity, and corruption at the center
Protagonist entangled in a web of lies, power, and betrayal
typical_settings: Bars, diners, police stations, cheap offices
Luxury spaces that contrast with seedy underworld
typical_conflicts: Investigating a crime that leads to deeper rot
Being hired into a job that goes wrong
protagonist_archetypes: Private detective, small-time crook, cop on the edge
Someone who can’t fully escape their own flaws
tone_guidelines: Cynical, fatalistic, often with hard-boiled narration and sharp dialogue.

required_elements: At least one serious crime as a key driver of the plot
Systemic corruption or moral compromise beyond a single 'bad person'
Moments where the protagonist’s own morality is tested or compromised
forbidden_elements: Neat and purely idealistic resolution where the system is clean and everyone is happy
